prose_scope: Original notes, plans and drafts; existing source mappings checked, omitted scientific content extracted. Counts are source records, not independent contributions.
additional_prose_scope: A separate bounded review covered deliverable reports, section versions, scientific syntheses and figures; repeated publication templates and non-scientific material were not imported. Counts do not imply that every stored file is a public research asset.

report_synthesis_review.boundary: Content mapping and corrections of existing evidence, not independent repetition of every historical scientific claim.

verification: Filesystem/source mapping and static checks only; no new training or evaluation.
